blocks.raw: ## Publicly Traded Partnership (PTP) Withholding
blocks.text: Publicly Traded Partnership (PTP) Withholding

blocks.raw: DriveWealth supports IRS-compliant withholding for U.S.-listed Publicly Traded Partnerships (PTPs) under Section 1446(f) of the Internal Revenue Code.
blocks.text: DriveWealth supports IRS-compliant withholding for U.S.-listed Publicly Traded Partnerships (PTPs) under Section 1446(f) of the Internal Revenue Code.

blocks.raw: For non-U.S. persons holding PTPs—such as certain master limited partnerships (MLPs)—DriveWealth automatically handles the 10% withholding on gross proceeds from sales.
blocks.text: For non-U.S. persons holding PTPs—such as certain master limited partnerships (MLPs)—DriveWealth automatically handles the 10% withholding on gross proceeds from sales.

blocks.raw: ## Non-Resident Withholding Tax on Dividend Equivalent Payments
blocks.text: Non-Resident Withholding Tax on Dividend Equivalent Payments

blocks.raw: Under IRS Section 871(m), a withholding tax is applied to Dividend Equivalent Payments (DEPs) received by foreign investors from derivatives or securities that reference dividends paid by U.S. Equities. Certain options transactions are eligible for this withholding.
blocks.text: Under IRS Section 871(m), a withholding tax is applied to Dividend Equivalent Payments (DEPs) received by foreign investors from derivatives or securities that reference dividends paid by U.S. Equities. Certain options transactions are eligible for this withholding.

blocks.raw: This withholding is applied on options transactions in certain underlying securities, in cases where the option contract substantially replicates the economic conditions of the underlying security. Specifically, this means it applies on option contracts where Delta = 1.
blocks.text: This withholding is applied on options transactions in certain underlying securities, in cases where the option contract substantially replicates the economic conditions of the underlying security. Specifically, this means it applies on option contracts where Delta = 1.

blocks.raw: When a customer holds a position that qualifies for this withholding, if they are not a US customer, an amount of that position value will be withheld and paid to the US IRS.
blocks.text: When a customer holds a position that qualifies for this withholding, if they are not a US customer, an amount of that position value will be withheld and paid to the US IRS.

blocks.raw: For example, if the Account holds a position in an eligible security during a dividend payment, and the delta of the held option contract is equal to 1, then a DEEM transaction will be applied to the Account.
blocks.text: For example, if the Account holds a position in an eligible security during a dividend payment, and the delta of the held option contract is equal to 1, then a DEEM transaction will be applied to the Account.

## Ongoing tax documentation
blocks.text: Ongoing tax documentation

blocks.raw: Throughout the lifecycle of an account, tax documents are generated as a result of activity incurred and taxes withheld by DriveWealth. All tax forms are calculated based upon the US tax season which is between January 1st, and December 31st.
blocks.text: Throughout the lifecycle of an account, tax documents are generated as a result of activity incurred and taxes withheld by DriveWealth. All tax forms are calculated based upon the US tax season which is between January 1st, and December 31st.

blocks.raw: Generally before the end of February, all tax forms are submitted by DriveWealth to the IRS for processing and acceptance. The day in which end of year forms are made available to end customers varies each year:
blocks.text: Generally before the end of February, all tax forms are submitted by DriveWealth to the IRS for processing and acceptance. The day in which end of year forms are made available to end customers varies each year:

blocks.raw:
| Initial form filed | End of year tax document | Availability time |
| :----------------- | :----------------------- | :---------------- |
| W-9                | 1099-Composite           | March             |
| W-8BEN             | 1042-S                   | April             |

blocks.raw: ## W-8BEN information updates
blocks.text: W-8BEN information updates

blocks.raw: The IRS requires that a customer updates their W-8BEN every 3 years, after the date of account creation. To facilitate the change in information, DriveWealth makes available two methods:
blocks.text: The IRS requires that a customer updates their W-8BEN every 3 years, after the date of account creation. To facilitate the change in information, DriveWealth makes available two methods:

blocks.raw:
* A hosted website: [DriveClient](https://client.drivewealth.com/login)
* The [User](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/patch_users-userid)  API
* The[`user.inforequired.created`](user.inforequired.created) Event
blocks.text: A hosted website: DriveClientThe User  APITheuser.inforequired.created Event

blocks.text: The primary points of information that need to be either confirmed or changed include:

* Full Legal Name
* Address
* Tax Identification Number
